heroStat.label: points on "We should be more ambitious with the software we build"

insights.text: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill shows its highest single-day star badge yet (2,878, total 47,330) but falls from a three-day #1 streak to #10 on GitHub Trending — the first time this page's five-day tracked run has seen rank and star velocity diverge this sharply.

debpalash/VoiceStudio debuts at #3 on GitHub Trending (87,330 stars): 'the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative' for voice cloning, video dubbing, and dictation in 646 languages, licensed AGPL-3.0 with CUDA/ROCm/Vulkan GPU acceleration and a local MCP server for agents.

ChatGPT's absence from Google Play's top-30, first logged yesterday, persists to a second consecutive day — one day short of the tracking page's own bar for confirming a genuine second absence thread. Claude's own absence reaches a tenth consecutive day.

minimaxir.com traces OpenAI and Anthropic's LLM API price cuts of up to 80% since mid-2026 to open-weight competitive pressure (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro) and thin provider moats (29 distinct OpenRouter providers), not pure generosity — while flagging, unresolved, that both companies are rumored to be IPOing soon.

NVIDIA's OpenShell, on GitHub Trending's board for three straight days through 10-25, is absent from today's capture — not yet distinguishable from a genuine falloff without a second day of confirmation.

Monday's Indie App Monetization rotation: 'ReadEra – book reader pdf epub' and 'Chat AI: Ask Agent Anything' extend a five-dated-capture suffix-keyword-stacking thread in Play Store app titles, still without install or revenue data behind any entry.

AutoGen co-authors Chi Wang and Qingyun Wu logged six combined commits/PRs to a new joint repo, sonichi/sutando, in the last 24 hours — worth a future deep-read given both authors' standing in the agent-framework-explosion thread.

Of today's 11-item GitHub Trending capture, 7 entries are agent, harness, or skill tooling rather than general-purpose software — continuing the concentration this page first measured at 8/10 on 2026-10-25.

takeaway.text: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill posts its biggest daily star gain yet but tumbles from #1 to #10 on GitHub Trending the same day a fully-local, AGPL-licensed ElevenLabs alternative debuts at #3 — rank and velocity are diverging on the harness-tooling board for the first time this run.
